project.name: brubru
project.description: AI-powered strategic advocacy assistant for EU policy professionals. Combines conversational AI with legislative tools to help users analyse policies, draft amendments, and navigate EU institutional processes.

nodes.name: amendments.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI router for the Amendator feature providing full CRUD for legislative amendments, batch operations, DOCX export, EUR-Lex law integration, AI-powered single and batch amendment suggestions, and AI text improvement with subscription tier gating.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses chunked parallel async AI calls (asyncio.gather) for batch amendment suggestions, with per-chunk JSON parsing and truncation repair.

nodes.name: create_amendment
nodes.summary: Creates a single legislative amendment, auto-linking it to a tracked carriage by CELEX number.

nodes.name: create_amendments_batch
nodes.summary: Creates multiple amendments in a single batch request with per-item error handling and auto-linking.

nodes.name: list_amendments
nodes.summary: Lists user amendments with pagination and optional filters by document, carriage, CELEX, status, and type.

nodes.name: suggest_amendment
nodes.summary: Generates a single AI-powered amendment suggestion based on policy position, original text, and optional supporting document context.

nodes.name: suggest_batch_amendments
nodes.summary: Generates document-wide AI amendment suggestions by chunking elements (recitals vs articles) and firing parallel AI calls, merging results into a single response.

nodes.name: improve_amendment_text
nodes.summary: AI-powered text polishing for user-drafted amendments, incorporating user documents and policy interests as context. Requires yellow+ tier.

nodes.name: export_amendments
nodes.summary: Exports all amendments for a document to DOCX format using the amendment export service.

nodes.name: auth.py
nodes.summary: Authentication API handling user registration, email/password login, Google and LinkedIn OAuth, JWT token management (creation, refresh, validation), profile updates, and anonymous pre-user chat linking.

nodes.name: verify_password
nodes.summary: Verifies a plain-text password against a PBKDF2-SHA256 hash.

nodes.name: create_access_token
nodes.summary: Creates a JWT access token with configurable expiration (default 7 days).

nodes.name: get_current_user
nodes.summary: FastAPI dependency that decodes JWT token, validates the user exists and is active, and returns the User object.

nodes.name: signup
nodes.summary: Registers a new user with email/password, defaulting to white (free) tier.

nodes.name: google_auth
nodes.summary: Authenticates via Google OAuth by verifying the ID token, creating or updating the user, and returning a JWT.

nodes.name: linkedin_callback
nodes.summary: Handles LinkedIn OAuth callback by exchanging authorization code for access token, fetching user info, and creating/updating the user.

nodes.name: chat.py
nodes.summary: Core chat API providing message send (with EU context injection), SSE streaming, conversation history/citations CRUD, and a debug endpoint for MEP name linking. Manages chat persistence via sync database helpers run in executors.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses asyncio.run_in_executor for sync DB operations, BackgroundTasks for non-blocking message persistence, and SSE streaming via StreamingResponse.

nodes.name: send_message
nodes.summary: Main chat endpoint: gets/creates conversation, builds history, calls AI service with EU context injection and 180s timeout, saves messages in background.

nodes.name: stream_message
nodes.summary: Streams AI chat response via Server-Sent Events, passing through status/entity JSON events and accumulating the full response for DB persistence.

nodes.name: _get_or_create_chat
nodes.summary: Sync helper that retrieves an existing chat with its message history or creates a new chat record, supporting pre-user anonymous sessions.

nodes.name: _save_messages
nodes.summary: Sync helper that persists user and assistant messages to the database, updates chat stats (message count, tokens, title auto-generation).

nodes.name: documents.py
nodes.summary: Documents API handling file upload (PDF/DOCX), EUR-Lex document fetching with WAF detection, EP RegData PDF fallback for COM documents, legislative structure parsing into amendable elements, and document CRUD.
nodes.languageNotes: Contains extensive legislative text parsing logic with fallback chains (EUR-Lex HTML -> EP RegData PDF -> text parsing) for robustly extracting amendable elements.

nodes.name: expand_articles_to_elements
nodes.summary: Flattens parsed legislative articles and recitals into a flat list of individually amendable elements (recitals, article titles, intros, paragraphs, subparagraphs).

nodes.name: upload_document
nodes.summary: Handles document upload (PDF/DOCX/DOC), processes content, stores in document storage and creates a user_documents record for AI context inclusion.

nodes.name: fetch_eurlex_document
nodes.summary: Fetches and parses EUR-Lex documents by URL or CELEX, with WAF detection, EP RegData PDF fallback, and legislative structure extraction for the Amendator UI.

nodes.name: eu_calendar.py
nodes.summary: EU Calendar API with endpoints for listing/filtering events by date range, institution, committee, and policy area; a today-digest with optional AI summary for Blue tier; reference data for institutions/policy areas; and sync triggers for committee/college agendas.

nodes.name: list_events
nodes.summary: Lists calendar events with filters for date range, institution, event type, committee code, policy area, and text search, with pagination.

nodes.name: get_today_digest
nodes.summary: Returns today's and tomorrow's calendar events, with an AI-generated summary for Blue tier users.

nodes.name: trigger_sync
nodes.summary: Triggers full calendar sync from all EU institutional sources. Restricted to Blue tier or admin users.

nodes.name: generate.py
nodes.summary: Document generation API providing AI-powered creation of position papers, MEP briefings, talking points, EP resolutions, and EP written questions. Each generated document is saved to user_documents for later retrieval.

nodes.name: generate_position_paper
nodes.summary: Generates a professional EU advocacy position paper from organisation details, policy stance, and key asks, saving the result to user documents.

nodes.name: generate_mep_briefing
nodes.summary: Generates a targeted MEP briefing note for engaging with a specific Member of the European Parliament.

nodes.name: generate_resolution
nodes.summary: Generates a European Parliament Resolution draft following the exact EP format (opening, having regards, whereas recitals, numbered points).

nodes.name: generate_ep_question
nodes.summary: Generates a European Parliament written question following the exact EP format with evidence-based context and numbered sub-questions.

nodes.name: predictions.py
nodes.summary: Comprehensive predictions API with endpoints for timeline forecasting, outcome prediction, EP plenary/committee vote prediction, group position analysis, cohesion scoring, delegation deviation prediction, QMV calculation, blocking minority analysis, Council vote prediction, member state position inference, and resolution leading indicators. Tier-gated across yellow/blue subscriptions.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines 12+ Pydantic response models inline alongside 15+ endpoints. Heavy use of lazy imports to avoid circular dependencies with prediction services.

nodes.name: predict_timeline
nodes.summary: Predicts days remaining for a legislative procedure using ML (XGBoost) with fallback to historical averages and then a default 180-day estimate.

nodes.name: predict_outcome
nodes.summary: Predicts the final outcome (adopted/blocked/withdrawn) of a legislative procedure with probability distribution.

nodes.name: predict_ep_vote
nodes.summary: Predicts EP plenary vote outcome including group-by-group breakdown, estimated vote counts, and swing group identification.

nodes.name: calculate_qmv
nodes.summary: Calculates Qualified Majority Voting outcome given supporting, opposing, and abstaining member states against 55%/65% thresholds.

nodes.name: predict_council_vote
nodes.summary: Predicts Council vote outcome by inferring member state positions from governing party affiliations, national interests, and historical patterns. Blue tier only.

nodes.name: get_resolution_leading_indicators
nodes.summary: Returns EP resolutions linked to a legislative procedure as predictive signals, using OEIL cross-references, Commission follow-ups, and title similarity matching.

nodes.name: require_tier
nodes.summary: Tier-gating helper that raises HTTPException if user's subscription tier is not in the allowed list (admin always bypasses).

nodes.name: rss_feeds.py
nodes.summary: RSS feed management API with endpoints for listing feeds/entries, subscribing/unsubscribing, institutional feed grouping, statistics, manual feed refresh, and on-demand AI enrichment (policy area classification, entity extraction, sentiment analysis).

nodes.name: enrich_entry
nodes.summary: On-demand AI enrichment for an RSS entry: classifies policy areas, extracts entities, detects CELEX/procedure references, and analyses sentiment.

nodes.name: stripe_payment.py
nodes.summary: Stripe payment integration supporting the modular pricing model with 9 products and 18 price IDs. Handles checkout session creation, customer portal, and webhook processing for subscription lifecycle events (checkout, update, cancel, payment success/failure).

nodes.name: create_checkout_session
nodes.summary: Creates a Stripe Checkout Session for subscription purchase, mapping plan name and billing period to the correct Stripe price ID and internal tier.

nodes.name: stripe_webhook
nodes.summary: Handles Stripe webhook events for checkout completion, subscription updates/cancellation, and payment success/failure, updating user tier accordingly.

nodes.name: subscriptions.py
nodes.summary: Subscription management API providing tier listings (legacy and modular pricing), usage statistics, direct upgrade endpoint for development/testing, and feature access checking against tier limits.

nodes.name: get_available_plans
nodes.summary: Returns the full modular pricing breakdown: 5 individual modules, 3 bundles (Starter/Advocate/Professional), and EP special plan with monthly/annual prices.

nodes.name: upgrade_subscription
nodes.summary: Direct subscription upgrade endpoint for development/testing (production upgrades go through Stripe). Prevents downgrades and sets expiration.

nodes.name: config.py
nodes.summary: Centralised application configuration using Pydantic BaseSettings, loading environment variables for database, AI providers (Mistral/Claude/GPT-4/Gemini), Stripe pricing (18 price IDs for 9 plans), email SMTP, Tavily search, and Tenderator TED API.

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.summary: Pydantic BaseSettings class that loads and validates all environment variables for the application, including AI keys, Stripe price IDs, SMTP, scraper config, and Tavily search settings.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses pydantic_settings BaseSettings with ConfigDict for .env file loading and type coercion.

nodes.name: database.py
nodes.summary: SQLAlchemy database configuration with environment-aware connection pooling (NullPool for production/serverless, QueuePool for development), session factory, declarative Base, and FastAPI dependency injection via get_db().

nodes.name: get_db
nodes.summary: FastAPI dependency that yields a SQLAlchemy session and ensures cleanup on completion, used across all API routes for database access.

nodes.name: init_db
nodes.summary: Initialises database by creating all SQLAlchemy model tables, called during application startup.

nodes.name: main.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI application entry point that bootstraps the Brubru backend: registers 30+ API routers, configures CORS, manages lifespan events (database init, RSS/email/amendment schedulers, MCP Toolbox), and provides health check endpoints.

nodes.name: lifespan
nodes.summary: Async context manager handling application startup (database init, RSS/email/amendment schedulers, MCP Toolbox connection) and graceful shutdown of all background services.

nodes.name: amendment.py
nodes.summary: SQLAlchemy model for legislative amendments in the Amendator feature, tracking change type (suppression/addition/modification), element position, justification, authorship, and status lifecycle from draft to adopted/rejected.

nodes.name: Amendment
nodes.summary: ORM model representing a legislative amendment with fields for document reference, element identification (recital/article/point), amendment type, original and proposed text, justification, and status tracking.

nodes.name: chat.py
nodes.summary: SQLAlchemy models for the AI chat system: Chat (conversation metadata, token/cost tracking, context settings, starring/sharing) and Message (individual user/assistant messages with AI response metadata and citations).

nodes.name: Chat
nodes.summary: ORM model for chat conversations with EU context injection settings, token usage tracking, cost calculation, message statistics, and serialisation methods for API responses.

nodes.name: Message
nodes.summary: ORM model for individual chat messages storing role (user/assistant), content, AI metadata (tokens, model, provider), and citation references.

nodes.name: eu_calendar.py
nodes.summary: SQLAlchemy models and enums for the EU Calendar feature: EUCalendarEvent (multi-institution events with policy areas, legislative cross-references, and source tracking) and UserCalendarSubscription (per-user reminders and notification preferences).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Python str+enum pattern for SQLAlchemy-compatible enums with values_callable for PostgreSQL enum type creation.

nodes.name: EUCalendarEvent
nodes.summary: ORM model for EU institutional calendar events supporting 12 institutions (EP, Council, Commission, ECB, etc.), 17 event types, policy area tagging, legislative procedure cross-references, and source deduplication.

nodes.name: UserCalendarSubscription
nodes.summary: ORM model for user calendar notification subscriptions, supporting both institution-level subscriptions (notify on new events) and per-event reminders with configurable timing.

nodes.name: legislative_train.py
nodes.summary: SQLAlchemy models for the EU Legislative Train Schedule: LegislativeTrain (EC priorities), LegislativePackage (thematic groupings with hierarchy), LegislativeCarriage (individual legislative files with OEIL/EUR-Lex enrichment), CarriageStatusHistory, and UserCarriageTrack (user watch subscriptions).

nodes.name: LegislativeTrain
nodes.summary: ORM model representing one of 7 EC priority 'trains' in the 2024-2029 Commission term, with file count statistics and relationships to packages and carriages.

nodes.name: LegislativePackage
nodes.summary: ORM model for thematic package groupings within the Legislative Train, supporting parent-child hierarchy (sub-packages), status counts per legislation stage, and EP committee/EC priority filtering.

nodes.name: LegislativeCarriage
nodes.summary: Core ORM model for individual legislative files tracking status progression, OEIL procedure references, EUR-Lex documents, EPRS briefings, committee assignments, AI-generated summaries, and timeline snapshots.

nodes.name: UserCarriageTrack
nodes.summary: ORM model for user subscriptions to watch specific legislative files, with configurable notifications for status changes, blocking events, and new documents.

nodes.name: user.py
nodes.summary: SQLAlchemy model for Brubru users with authentication (password hash + OAuth), personalisation (name, timezone, language, background), subscription tier management (white/yellow/blue), Stripe integration, and policy interest tracking.

nodes.name: User
nodes.summary: Core user model with authentication fields (password hash, OAuth provider), subscription tier (white/yellow/blue with Stripe IDs), personalisation settings (language, timezone, background), and backward-compatible policy interest parsing.

nodes.name: knowledge_loader.py
nodes.summary: Massive knowledge base loader (~3,500 lines) that manages ~1,840 keyword triggers mapped to 69 EU policy guides, loads JSON reference data (calendars, institutions, organigrammes), templates, and requirement clusters, and provides two-pass search (keyword triggers first, content fallback) for AI context injection.
nodes.languageNotes: Contains a ~2,200-line GUIDE_KEYWORD_TRIGGERS dictionary mapping multilingual keyword phrases to guide file stems, acting as a hand-curated search index.

nodes.name: KnowledgeLoader
nodes.summary: Central knowledge base service that loads and indexes calendars, institutions, templates, organigrammes, guides, and requirement clusters from disk, providing query methods for commissioners, committees, DG personnel, and two-pass guide search with keyword triggers.

nodes.name: get_knowledge_loader
nodes.summary: Singleton factory function that returns a lazily-initialised KnowledgeLoader instance, loading all knowledge base data on first call.

nodes.name: context_builder.py
nodes.summary: Massive context builder (~5,600 lines) that assembles EU-specific context for AI chat responses by orchestrating entity extraction, parallel API calls (EUR-Lex, OEIL, EP, Tavily), database queries (legislative train, calendar, consultations, EPRS), knowledge base lookups, DG organigramme resolution, and source-tier-ranked citation formatting.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Python dataclasses (DraftingIntent, ExtractedEntities, ContextData) and extensive asyncio.gather for parallel API fetching across 15+ data sources.

nodes.name: ContextBuilder
nodes.summary: Core AI context assembly engine with 30+ methods: builds rich EU policy context from user queries by extracting entities (CELEX, procedure refs, MEP names), fetching from multiple APIs in parallel, querying the knowledge base and database, detecting drafting intent, and formatting tiered source citations for the AI system prompt.

nodes.name: DraftingIntent
nodes.summary: Dataclass representing detected drafting/action intent from a user query, including action word, document type, topic, and confidence score.

nodes.name: ContextData
nodes.summary: Dataclass aggregating all context retrieved for a query: legislation, procedures, MEPs, RSS items, knowledge base content, committee work, consultations, calendar events, web search results, EU institutional search, Beresol content, and user documents.

nodes.name: ExtractedEntities
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding entities extracted from user text: CELEX numbers, procedure references, MEP names, committee codes, and topic keywords.

nodes.name: multi_provider_service.py
nodes.summary: Implements a 4-tier AI provider fallback chain (Mistral -> Claude Haiku -> Claude Sonnet -> GPT-4 -> Gemini) with automatic failover, daily spend caps for Haiku, and a global singleton orchestrator.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses ABC abstract base class for provider interface, dataclass for response, and async/await for all AI provider calls.

nodes.name: AIProvider
nodes.summary: Abstract base class defining the interface for all AI providers with name, availability check, and async generate method.

nodes.name: MistralProvider
nodes.summary: Mistral AI provider implementation (primary, most cost-effective at $0.20/1M input tokens) with async chat completion.

nodes.name: AnthropicHaikuProvider
nodes.summary: Claude Haiku 4.5 provider used for knowledge-heavy queries, routed to when knowledge guides or EU institutional search results are present.

nodes.name: AnthropicProvider
nodes.summary: Claude Sonnet 4 provider serving as fallback 1 in the provider chain.

nodes.name: OpenAIProvider
nodes.summary: OpenAI GPT-4 Turbo provider serving as fallback 2, with message format conversion from Anthropic to OpenAI format.

nodes.name: GeminiProvider
nodes.summary: Google Gemini 1.5 Pro provider as fallback 3, wrapping the sync Gemini SDK in async executor calls.

nodes.name: MultiProviderService
nodes.summary: Orchestrator that manages the AI provider fallback chain with daily Haiku spend cap ($2.50/day), prefer_claude routing for knowledge queries, and comprehensive error handling across all providers.

nodes.name: get_multi_provider_service
nodes.summary: Global singleton factory for MultiProviderService, lazily initialized on first call.

nodes.name: ai_service.py
nodes.summary: Core AI chat service that orchestrates EU context injection via ContextBuilder, multi-provider fallback, conversation memory, MEP name linkification, legislation link injection, knowledge gap detection, analytics logging, and action button computation for the Brubru chatbot.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of async/await with asyncio.create_task for non-blocking analytics and gap logging. Dataclasses for message/response structures.

nodes.name: AIService
nodes.summary: Main AI service class handling chat requests with EU context injection, streaming support, multi-provider fallback, post-processing (MEP linkification, legislation links, citation stripping), knowledge gap detection, and analytics logging.

nodes.name: get_ai_service
nodes.summary: Global singleton factory for AIService, initializing with Anthropic API key and ContextBuilder.

nodes.name: daily_brief_email.py
nodes.summary: Builds and sends the daily EU policy brief email to subscribers using BCC batching (90 per batch) via Gmail SMTP, with headline hover effects, unsubscribe links, duplicate prevention, and support for extra campaign recipients.

nodes.name: send_welcome_brief
nodes.summary: Sends a welcome email with today's headlines to a newly captured email address.

nodes.name: send_daily_brief_batch
nodes.summary: Sends the daily brief to all subscribers (registered users + pre-users + extras) via BCC batches of 90, with duplicate prevention via daily_brief_sends table.

nodes.name: email_service.py
nodes.summary: Gmail SMTP email service providing single and bulk send capabilities, plus HTML email templates for welcome and re-engagement emails, used as the foundation for all outbound email in Brubru.

nodes.name: EmailService
nodes.summary: Gmail SMTP email client with TLS, supporting single send and bulk send operations with error handling for authentication and recipient failures.

nodes.name: build_welcome_back_email
nodes.summary: Builds an HTML re-engagement email for inactive users with personalized greeting and days-since-login count.

nodes.name: build_first_time_welcome_email
nodes.summary: Builds an HTML welcome email for newly registered users with three getting-started suggestions.

nodes.name: get_email_service
nodes.summary: Global singleton factory for EmailService.

nodes.name: App.tsx
nodes.summary: Root React application component defining all routes (public landing/auth/policy pages and protected feature pages), wrapping them with GoogleOAuthProvider, BrowserRouter, TourProvider, Header/Footer, and animated page transitions.

nodes.name: App
nodes.summary: Root component that sets up React Router with 15+ routes (public and protected), Google OAuth provider, tour provider, cookie consent, and page transition animations.

nodes.name: eu_calendar_tab.tsx
nodes.summary: EU Calendar tab component for My EU Bubble featuring month/week/day views, institution and policy area filter chips, My EU Today digest panel, event detail modal with procedure deep-links, and responsive mobile event list.

nodes.name: EUCalendarTab
nodes.summary: Main exported calendar component that composes digest, toolbar, filters, and view (month/week/day) sub-components with loading skeleton.

nodes.name: EventDetailModal
nodes.summary: Portal-rendered modal showing event details including date, type, description, committee info, procedure deep-links to Predictions/Files/Amendator, and agenda/source URLs.

nodes.name: predictions_tab.tsx
nodes.summary: Predictions tab component for My EU Bubble displaying AI-powered legislative outcome predictions with confidence gauges, EP group vote breakdown, timeline projections, Council risk assessment, resolution leading indicators, tier-based access control, and file picker modal.

nodes.name: PredictionsTab
nodes.summary: Main predictions component handling tier-based access (white=locked, yellow=quota, blue=unlimited), auto-loading predictions from URL params, file picker integration, and rendering prediction cards.

nodes.name: PredictionCard
nodes.summary: Expandable card component showing prediction confidence gauge, outcome/timeline/EP vote/Council metrics, and expanded details with EP group breakdown, timeline projection, Council risk, and resolution leading indicators.

nodes.name: chat_interface.tsx
nodes.summary: Primary chat interface component implementing both standard and streaming message exchange with the Brubru AI backend, including pre-user query limits with progressive CTAs, conversation history loading, entity detection, action buttons, and email capture flow.

nodes.name: ChatInterface
nodes.summary: Main chat component managing message state, streaming/non-streaming API calls, pre-user query limiting (3 free), progressive CTAs, personalized greetings, example prompts from admin API, and action button routing.

nodes.name: daily_brief.tsx
nodes.summary: Dashboard welcome grid component displayed in the chat empty state, showing a 2x2 card layout with today's top headline, example prompts, expandable additional headlines, and an animated knowledge stats ticker.

nodes.name: DailyBrief
nodes.summary: Renders a 2x2 card grid with the top headline and 3 example prompts, plus expandable headlines and a rotating stats ticker showing guide/file counts.

nodes.name: use_eu_calendar.ts
nodes.summary: Zustand store for EU Calendar state management including event fetching with date range calculation, view mode switching (month/week/day), institution/policy/committee filters, My EU Today digest, and helper functions for grouping events by date.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Zustand create() with get/set pattern for a complex state store with derived data helper exports.

nodes.name: groupEventsByDate
nodes.summary: Groups calendar events into a Map keyed by ISO date string for use in month and week views.

nodes.name: use_subscription.ts
nodes.summary: Zustand store managing subscription state including usage stats, tier fetching, Stripe checkout session creation, and customer portal access.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Zustand create<T> with TypeScript generics for typed state management. Interfaces define UsageStats, SubscriptionTier, and SubscriptionState.

nodes.name: useSubscription
nodes.summary: Zustand store providing fetchUsage, fetchTiers, upgrade, checkFeatureAccess, createCheckoutSession, and createPortalSession actions for subscription management and Stripe integration.

nodes.name: main.tsx
nodes.summary: Application entry point that conditionally hydrates pre-rendered HTML (for SEO/AI crawlers) or mounts a fresh React root, wrapping the App component in StrictMode.

nodes.name: amendator_page.tsx
nodes.summary: Main page component for the Amendator legislative amendment editor, featuring a unified sidebar with Amendments and AI Assistant tabs, two-column document layout, CELEX deep-linking, and batch amendment saving.
nodes.languageNotes: Exports several TypeScript types/interfaces (AmendmentType, AmendmentStatus, StructureLevel, TextChange, Amendment) used across the Amendator feature.

nodes.name: AmendatorPage
nodes.summary: React component orchestrating the Amendator page: manages sidebar tabs (amendments/AI), document loading from CELEX params, cell amendment state, AI suggestion acceptance, and batch save to backend API.

nodes.name: landing_page.tsx
nodes.summary: Public-facing marketing landing page with hero video, feature tracklist, story timeline, pricing cards (Starter/Advocate/Professional), client logos, about section with founder bio, and CTA with word-by-word animation.

nodes.name: LandingPage
nodes.summary: React component rendering the full landing page with IntersectionObserver-driven fade-up animations, scroll-snap sections, i18n-translated content, and language selector.

nodes.name: main_page.tsx
nodes.summary: Primary chat page with sidebar showing conversation history grouped by date (Today/Yesterday/This Week/Older), document upload for authenticated users, and the ChatInterface component for AI conversations.

nodes.name: MainPage
nodes.summary: React component managing the Brubru Chat page: fetches conversation list, renders grouped history sidebar, handles new/resume chat, passes initial question from route state to ChatInterface.

nodes.name: groupConversations
nodes.summary: Groups an array of conversations into Today, Yesterday, This Week, and Older buckets based on their last message timestamp.

nodes.name: formatRelativeTime
nodes.summary: Formats a date string into a relative time label (now, Nm, Nh, Nd, or short month/day) for conversation list display.

nodes.name: my_eu_bubble_page.tsx
nodes.summary: Hub page for My EU Bubble featuring 9 tabbed views (Dashboard, My Files, EU Calendar, Predictions, Consultations, Documents, Amendments, Legislative Tracker, Analytics) with tier-gated content and a news sidebar.

nodes.name: MyEUBubblePage
nodes.summary: React component rendering the My EU Bubble dashboard with URL-driven tab selection, subscription-tier gating for Calendar and Consultations, custom background support, and a gradient-styled Predictions tab.

nodes.name: subscription_page.tsx
nodes.summary: Subscription/pricing page displaying bundle cards (Starter/Advocate/Professional), EP Plan banner, individual module cards, feature comparison table, trust logos, FAQ, and Stripe checkout integration.

nodes.name: SubscriptionPage
nodes.summary: React component rendering the full subscription page with monthly/annual billing toggle, 3 bundle cards, EP plan banner, 5 module cards, feature comparison table, FAQ, and Stripe checkout via useSubscription hook.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: API package init that re-exports the chat router module, serving as the barrel file for FastAPI routers.

nodes.name: admin_analytics.py
nodes.summary: Admin-only FastAPI router providing dashboard metrics (chat volume, provider distribution, knowledge gaps, feedback), conversation quality scoring, low-scoring conversation detection, and analytics export in JSON/CSV.

nodes.name: get_dashboard_metrics
nodes.summary: Returns aggregated admin dashboard metrics including total messages, response times, token usage, provider distribution, knowledge gap rates, feedback counts, and daily breakdown for charting.

nodes.name: get_conversation_quality_list
nodes.summary: Returns a paginated list of conversations with message counts, token usage, response times, and knowledge gap counts for admin quality review.

nodes.name: export_analytics
nodes.summary: Exports raw chat analytics data in JSON or CSV format for external analysis, limited to 10,000 records.

nodes.name: get_conversation_quality
nodes.summary: Calculates and returns the quality score (0-10) with rating and breakdown for a specific conversation using the ConversationQualityService.

nodes.name: get_quality_aggregate
nodes.summary: Returns aggregate quality statistics (average score, distribution, total analysed) across conversations for a given time period.

nodes.name: get_low_scoring_conversations
nodes.summary: Identifies and returns conversations with quality scores below a given threshold, sorted worst-first, for admin review of problematic interactions.

nodes.name: admin_auth.py
nodes.summary: Provides FastAPI dependency functions for admin authorization: get_current_admin_user (raises 403 for non-admins) and is_admin helper, used to protect admin-only endpoints.

nodes.name: get_current_admin_user
nodes.summary: FastAPI dependency that verifies the current user has admin role, raising HTTP 403 if not. Used to guard admin-only endpoints.

nodes.name: is_admin
nodes.summary: Simple helper that returns True if the given User object has admin role.

nodes.name: admin_eu_comply.py
nodes.summary: Admin API endpoints for EU Law Comply feature: triggers requirement extraction from law clusters, builds semantic search indexes, provides similarity search, and exposes a RAG chatbot for compliance questions.

nodes.name: get_clusters_stats
nodes.summary: Returns statistics for all law clusters including law counts, requirement counts, and extraction job status.

nodes.name: run_extraction_with_tracking
nodes.summary: Background task that runs requirement extraction for a law cluster, tracking progress in an in-memory dictionary.

nodes.name: run_extraction_with_model
nodes.summary: Background task that runs requirement extraction using a specified AI model (gpt-4, saul-7b, llama, mistral) with progress tracking.

nodes.name: ask_chatbot
nodes.summary: RAG chatbot endpoint that retrieves relevant requirements and generates compliance answers for admin users.

nodes.name: admin_panel.py
nodes.summary: Comprehensive admin panel API with user CRUD, RSS feed management, system statistics dashboard, scraper control, activity logging, and re-engagement email campaign endpoints.

nodes.name: get_all_users
nodes.summary: Lists all users with search, role/status filtering, and pagination. Logs admin activity.

nodes.name: get_system_stats
nodes.summary: Aggregates system-wide statistics: user counts, feed counts, entry counts, subscriptions, and feedback metrics for the admin dashboard.

nodes.name: send_reengagement_emails
nodes.summary: Sends re-engagement emails to inactive users and first-time welcome emails, with dry-run preview mode.

nodes.name: admin_tenders.py
nodes.summary: Admin endpoints for Tenderator feature management: tender CRUD with bulk delete, TED API/SPARQL fetch job triggers, user-tender matching, notification dispatch, profile management, statistics dashboard, settings, and CSV/JSON export.

nodes.name: list_tenders
nodes.summary: Lists all tenders with multi-field filtering (country, status, CPV, value range), sorting, pagination, and match counts.

nodes.name: get_admin_stats
nodes.summary: Computes comprehensive Tenderator statistics: tender counts by status/country/sector, profile and match metrics, fetch job history.

nodes.name: export_tenders
nodes.summary: Exports tenders data in CSV or JSON format with optional status and country filters.

nodes.name: auth_optional.py

nodes.summary: ORM model for EU public procurement tenders from TED, storing eForms data (CPV codes, NUTS regions, lots, award criteria), raw XML/JSON, AI-generated SME suitability scores, and serialisation methods for API responses.

nodes.name: TenderProfile
nodes.summary: Stores user preferences for tender matching including company info, CPV/geographic/value filters, certification capabilities, and notification settings. Blue-tier only.

nodes.name: TenderMatch
nodes.summary: Junction model linking tenders to user profiles with match scores, reason breakdowns (JSONB), user actions (viewed/saved/dismissed/applied), and notification tracking.

nodes.name: TenderFetchJob
nodes.summary: Tracks tender fetch job execution with status, counts of found/new/updated tenders, timing, and error details for monitoring and debugging.

nodes.name: TenderatorSettings
nodes.summary: Singleton configuration model for the Tenderator feature, storing default fetch parameters, matching thresholds, and notification settings.

nodes.name: text_adopted.py
nodes.summary: Defines SQLAlchemy models for EP adopted texts (resolutions, legislative resolutions, decisions) with cross-references to legislative carriages and a user tracking model for watchlists.

nodes.name: TextAdopted
nodes.summary: ORM model for EP plenary adopted texts storing TA references, procedure refs, committee/rapporteur info, vote results, and a FK link to LegislativeCarriage for cross-referencing legislative files.

nodes.name: UserTextAdoptedTrack
nodes.summary: User tracking/watchlist model for adopted texts, following the same pattern as UserCommitteeWorkTrack with unique user+text constraint.

nodes.name: user_document.py
nodes.summary: Defines the UserDocument SQLAlchemy model for user-created content in My EU Bubble (amendments, analyses, strategies, notes, uploaded files) with versioning, EU legislation cross-links, AI context control, and privacy/sharing settings.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses doc_metadata instead of metadata to avoid SQLAlchemy reserved attribute conflict. Self-referential FK for version history (parent_document_id).

nodes.name: UserDocument
nodes.summary: Polymorphic document model supporting amendments, analyses, strategies, notes, and uploaded files with type-specific fields, self-referential versioning, EU legislation links (CELEX/procedure), and a create_new_version method for document history.

nodes.name: user_feed_read.py
nodes.summary: Defines the UserFeedRead SQLAlchemy model for tracking which RSS entries users have read, with reading time metrics and engagement analytics (quick/thorough read classification).

nodes.name: UserFeedRead
nodes.summary: Tracks per-user RSS entry read status with reading time, read count, click-through tracking, and computed properties classifying reads as quick (<30s) or thorough (>2min).

nodes.name: user_feed_subscription.py
nodes.summary: Defines the UserFeedSubscription SQLAlchemy model for tracking which RSS feeds users subscribe to, with activation toggle and notification preferences.

nodes.name: UserFeedSubscription
nodes.summary: Maps users to RSS feeds with active/inactive toggle, notification preference, and computed properties for subscription age and new-user detection.

nodes.name: user_saved_entry.py
nodes.summary: Defines the UserSavedEntry SQLAlchemy model for bookmarked RSS entries with user annotations (notes, tags), collection grouping, star/reminder features, and computed properties for reminder logic.

nodes.name: UserSavedEntry
nodes.summary: Allows users to bookmark RSS entries with personal notes, tags, collection grouping, star flags, and reminder scheduling with a computed needs_reminder property.

layers.name: API Layer
layers.description: FastAPI route handlers for all backend endpoints including chat, amendments, predictions, calendar, payments, admin panels, and CRUD operations across 30+ feature routers.

layers.name: Service Layer
layers.description: Core business logic including the AI chat orchestrator, multi-provider fallback chain, EU context builder with knowledge base integration, and email/daily brief services.

layers.name: Data Layer
layers.description: SQLAlchemy ORM models defining 30+ database tables for users, chat, amendments, legislative tracking, EU institutional data, tenders, compliance, predictions, and RSS feeds.

layers.name: Configuration and Bootstrap Layer
layers.description: Application entry points and foundational configuration including FastAPI app bootstrap, database connection pooling, environment variable loading, and Stripe/AI provider credentials.

layers.name: Frontend Pages and Routing
layers.description: React page components and application routing for the SPA including the landing page, chat interface, My EU Bubble hub, Amendator editor, subscription page, and entry point with conditional hydration.

layers.name: Frontend Components and State
layers.description: Reusable React UI components (chat interface, calendar tab, predictions tab, daily brief) and Zustand state management hooks for EU calendar and subscription data.

tour.title: Backend Entry Point
tour.description: The FastAPI application starts in backend/main.py, which imports configuration and database modules, registers all API routers, and defines the application lifespan (including database initialisation via init_db). This file is the single point where the entire backend is assembled and gives you a map of every feature area through its router imports.

tour.title: Core Infrastructure
tour.description: Two foundational files underpin every backend module. config.py centralises all environment variables (API keys for four AI providers, 18 Stripe price IDs, database URLs) using Pydantic Settings. database.py creates the SQLAlchemy async engine and session factory, and exposes init_db() called at startup. Nearly every API router and service imports one or both of these files.
tour.languageLesson: Pydantic Settings (BaseSettings) automatically reads environment variables and validates them at startup, providing type-safe configuration with zero boilerplate parsing code.

tour.title: Domain Models
tour.description: SQLAlchemy ORM models define the database schema and domain vocabulary. The User model is the most imported file in the codebase, referenced by virtually every API router for authentication and authorisation. Other key models include Chat (conversations and messages), Amendment (legislative text edits), LegislativeTrain (EU procedure tracking), and EUCalendarEvent (institutional calendar). All models inherit from the Base declarative class created in database.py.

tour.title: Authentication Layer
tour.description: Two auth modules gate access to the API. auth.py implements JWT-based authentication with Google and LinkedIn OAuth support, returning the current User from the database. auth_optional.py wraps auth.py to allow unauthenticated access in development mode and optional auth for public-facing endpoints. Every protected router depends on one of these two modules.

tour.title: AI Chat -- The Primary Feature
tour.description: The chat router is Brubru's centrepiece. When a user sends a message, the send_message or stream_message endpoint creates or retrieves a conversation, delegates to ai_service.py for the AI response, and persists both the user message and AI reply. The router imports the context builder to inject EU-specific knowledge before the AI generates its answer. This is the feature that most directly serves the 'Weekly Active Paid Users' metric.

tour.title: AI Service and Multi-Provider Routing
tour.description: Building on the chat router from Step 5, ai_service.py orchestrates the full AI response pipeline: it calls the context builder to gather EU knowledge, constructs the system prompt with domain-specific rules, and routes the query to the appropriate provider. multi_provider_service.py implements a four-tier fallback chain (Claude Haiku as de facto primary, then Mistral, GPT-4, and Gemini) with daily spend caps and automatic failover.
tour.languageLesson: The multi-provider service uses Python's async/await with try/except chains to implement the fallback pattern -- each provider is attempted in sequence, and failures are caught and logged before trying the next provider.

tour.title: Context Builder and Knowledge Base
tour.description: The context builder is the intelligence layer that makes Brubru's AI responses domain-specific rather than generic. It searches 69 knowledge guides via keyword triggers, enriches legislative files with OEIL procedural data, queries EPRS publications from PostgreSQL, and falls back to searching 25 trusted EU institutional domains via Tavily when no guide matches. The knowledge_loader.py manages guide discovery with a two-pass search (keyword triggers first, content search fallback).

tour.title: Legislative and RSS Data Models
tour.description: Beyond chat, Brubru tracks EU legislative activity and news. The RSS models (rss_feed.py and rss_entry.py) store aggregated news from 15+ EU institutional sources for the My EU Bubble feature. Supporting models like eu_law.py (cached legislation for compliance checking), tender.py (EU procurement opportunities), and eprs_publication.py (Parliament research briefings) round out the data layer that feeds both the AI context and dedicated UI features.

tour.title: Feature API Routers
tour.description: Each product feature has a dedicated FastAPI router. amendments.py handles CRUD for legislative text edits (Amendator), eu_law_comply.py runs compliance gap analysis, generate.py produces AI-powered position papers and MEP briefings, predictions.py provides AI legislative outcome forecasts, and eu_calendar.py aggregates institutional events from six data sources. All routers follow the same pattern: import auth, database, and relevant models, then define REST endpoints.

tour.title: Payments and Subscriptions
tour.description: Brubru uses a modular pricing model with nine Stripe products (five individual modules and four bundles). stripe_payment.py maps plan names to Stripe price IDs and creates checkout sessions. subscriptions.py exposes the full pricing breakdown. Internally, the nine plans map to just three access tiers (white/yellow/blue) that gate feature access throughout the codebase, with only the Professional bundle granting blue-tier access.

tour.title: Email and Daily Brief System
tour.description: The daily brief is a key activation tool for driving weekly engagement. daily_brief_email.py fetches the latest EU headlines, builds an HTML email with Brubru's brand styling, and sends it via BCC batching (90 recipients per SMTP connection) through email_service.py. The email service wraps Gmail SMTP with Google Workspace credentials and handles rate limiting constraints (~2,000 recipients/day).

tour.title: Frontend Entry and Routing
tour.description: The React frontend starts in main.tsx, which imports the root App component and mounts it to the DOM with conditional hydration for pre-rendered pages. App.tsx defines the client-side routing (React Router) that maps URL paths to page components like MainPage, SubscriptionPage, and the various feature pages. This mirrors the backend router structure from Step 9.
tour.languageLesson: The conditional hydration pattern in main.tsx checks whether the page was server-pre-rendered (for SEO/AI crawlers) and uses React's hydrateRoot instead of createRoot, preserving the static HTML while adding interactivity.

tour.title: Chat Interface -- Frontend
tour.description: The main_page.tsx component is the primary user-facing page, embedding the chat_interface.tsx component that handles message input, streaming AI responses, conversation history grouping, and featured question cards. The daily_brief.tsx component is imported into the chat interface to surface the latest EU policy briefing directly within the conversation view, tying the email engagement loop (Step 11) back into the product.

tour.title: Subscription and Calendar UI
tour.description: The subscription_page.tsx renders the modular pricing UI (billing toggle, bundle cards, module cards, feature comparison table) and calls use_subscription.ts to create Stripe checkout sessions. The eu_calendar_tab.tsx provides month/week/day views of EU institutional events using the use_eu_calendar.ts Zustand store. Both demonstrate the frontend pattern of pairing page components with dedicated hooks for state management and API calls.
tour.languageLesson: Zustand is used instead of Redux for state management -- each feature gets a lightweight store created with a single 'create' call, avoiding Redux's boilerplate of actions, reducers, and dispatchers while still providing React hook integration.

tour.title: Admin and Analytics
tour.description: The admin layer provides operational visibility. admin_auth.py restricts access to admin-only users, while admin_analytics.py exposes dashboard metrics, conversation quality scores, knowledge gaps, and user feedback. admin_panel.py manages users and RSS feeds. These endpoints support the WAPU-driven development process by surfacing the data needed to diagnose chatbot quality and user engagement daily.
